name: Melo token missing access control on critical function
summary: A MEL function that moves tokens out of the liquidity pair has no access control, so the attacker called it to strip the pair and swapped the imbalance for its USDT.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
